english_text: I was reminded that I can bring a family member for support.
sesotho_text: Ke khumamisitsoe hore nka tlisa leloko la lelapa bakeng sa tshehetso.

english_text: I was told that my treatment is confidential.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore phekolo ea ka ke sephiri.

english_text: I was reminded that I have the right to ask questions.
sesotho_text: Ke khumamisitsoe hore ke na le tokelo ea ho botsa lipotso.

english_text: I was told that I can request a different healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore nka kopa mofani o mocha oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: I was reminded that I can complain if I am not treated well.
sesotho_text: Ke khumamisitsoe hore nka ngongorehela haeba ha ke phethoe hantle.

english_text: I was told that my feedback helps improve the clinic's services.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore maikutlo a ka a thusa ho ntlafatsa litšebeletso tsa kliniki.

english_text: I need to attend my follow-up appointment next Monday.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho tla appointment ea ka ea ho latela Mantaheng e tlang.

english_text: I must not miss my three-month ART review.
sesotho_text: Ha ke tlameha ho lahlehela ho hlahloba ART ea ka ea likhoeli tse tharo.

english_text: I have to go back to the clinic for my test results.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho khutla klinikeng bakeng sa liphetho tsa tlhahlobo ea ka.

english_text: I should not skip my TB treatment follow-up.
sesotho_text: Ha ke lokela ho tlohela ho latela phekolo ea TB ea ka.

english_text: I must remember to take my medication before the appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho hopola ho nka moriana oa ka pele ho appointment.

english_text: I have to bring my clinic card to every visit.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho tlisa karete ea ka ea kliniki tsebeliso le 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.

english_text: I should keep a record of my symptoms before the appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke lokela ho boloka rekoto ea matšoao a ka pele ho appointment.

english_text: I must inform the clinic if I change my phone number.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho tsebisa kliniki haeba ke fetola nomoro ea ka ea mohala.

english_text: I have to let the clinic know if I move to a different area.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho tsebisa kliniki haeba ke fetohela sebakeng se seng.

english_text: I should transfer my file if I move to another clinic.
sesotho_text: Ke lokela ho fetisa faele ea ka haeba ke fetohela klinikeng e nngwe.

english_text: I must collect my medication before it runs out.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho kga moriana oa ka pele ho fela.

english_text: I have to request a repeat prescription at my follow-up.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho kopa prescription e phindoang ho latela ha ka.

english_text: I should ask the doctor about any concerns at my next visit.
sesotho_text: Ke lokela ho botsa ngaka ka mathata afe kafe tsebelisong ea ka e latelang.

english_text: I must tell the nurse if I experience any new side effects.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho bolella mooki haeba ke ikutloa litlamorao tse ncha tse ling.

english_text: I have to complete my full course of treatment.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho phetela khoroso yohle ea phekolo ea ka.

english_text: I should not stop my medication without consulting the doctor.
sesotho_text: Ha ke lokela ho emisa moriana oa ka ntle le ho buisana le ngaka.

english_text: I must attend all my scheduled appointments without fail.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho tla li-appointment tsohle tse reretseng ntle le ho hloleha.

english_text: I have to follow the treatment plan given by my doctor.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho latela leano la phekolo le fanoeng ke ngaka ea ka.

english_text: I should report to the clinic immediately if I feel very unwell.
sesotho_text: Ke lokela ho tsebisa kliniki hang hang haeba ke ikutloa ke sa phela hantle haholo.

english_text: I must go to the emergency room if my condition worsens at night.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho ea kamoreng ea tšohanyetso haeba boemo ba ka bo mpe bosiu.

english_text: I have to call the clinic helpline if I have urgent questions.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho letsetsa mohala oa thuso ea kliniki haeba ke na le lipotso tsa potlako.

english_text: I should keep the clinic's contact number saved on my phone.
sesotho_text: Ke lokela ho boloka nomoro ea ho ikopanya ea kliniki mohaling oa ka.

english_text: I must not share my medication with other people.
sesotho_text: Ha ke tlameha ho arolelana moriana oa ka le batho ba bang.

english_text: I have to store my medication safely away from children.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho boloka moriana oa ka ka polokeho hole le bana.

english_text: I should take my medication at the same time every day.
sesotho_text: Ke lokela ho nka moriana oa ka ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: I must not take double doses if I miss one.
sesotho_text: Ha ke tlameha ho nka li-dose tse habeli haeba ke lahlehetsoe ke e le ngoe.

english_text: I have to tell the doctor if I vomit after taking my medication.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho bolella ngaka haeba ke hlatsa ka mor'a ho nka moriana oa ka.

english_text: I should drink enough water when taking my medication.
sesotho_text: Ke lokela ho noa metsi a lekaneng ha ke nka moriana oa ka.

english_text: I must avoid certain foods that interact with my medication.
sesotho_text: Ke tlameha ho hana lijo tse ling tse kopanang le moriana oa ka.
